source_text: Diligens lector confert praeterita praesentibus; differentia non fortuita. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: The careful reader compares past things with present; the difference is not by chance. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: A careful reader compares earlier and later oracles; the shift from singular to plural is no accident. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
